R.S.A. c. F28 Financial Services Enactments Regulations R.R.A. F28-1
Revised Regulations of Anguilla: F28-1
FINANCIAL SERVICES COMMISSION ACT (R.S.A. c. F28)
FINANCIAL SERVICES ENACTMENTS REGULATIONS
Note: These Regulations are enabled under section 60 of the Financial Services Commission Act, R.S.A.
c. F28.*
Financial Services Enactments
1. The following Acts shall be prescribed as “Financial Services Enactments” for the purposes of the
Financial Services Commission Act—
(a) Company Management Act;
(b) Co-operative Societies Act;
(c) Fraudulent Dispositions Act;
(d) Friendly Societies Act;
(e) Insurance Act;
(Act 4/2013, s. 53)
(f) Money Services Businesses Act;
(R.A. 35/2011, s. 1)
(g) Mutual Funds Act;
(h) Protected Cell Companies Act†;
(i) Trust Companies and Offshore Banking Act;
(j) Anguilla Utility Token Offering Act;
(R.A. 25/2018, s. 2)
(k) Trusts Act;
(l) Anguilla Utility Tokens Exchange Act.
(R.A. 91/2020, s. 2)
Citation
2. These Regulations may be cited as the Financial Services Enactments Regulations, Revised Regulations
of Anguilla, F28-1.
___________
* This Note has been corrected to reflect the renumbering of the Act by Act 11 of 2022.
† Business Companies Act, 2022 (Act 2/2022) repealed the Protected Cell Companies Act, R.S.A. c. P107.
